category: inference gateway, keyless free public beta

free_tier.stated: Free public beta with no key required: 18 models live, auth is optional and a placeholder of dashes is accepted; the anonymous tier is 8 requests per 10 s
free_tier.notes: GET /v1/models lists 18 ids; the page labels three backends (Cloudflare Workers AI, freeAI gateways, SurfSense) plus NVIDIA NIM, and which model actually serves an id with another vendor's name is not observed

tooling: POST /v1/chat with {"model": id, "messages": [...]}; the chat route is /v1/chat, not /v1/chat/completions, which answers "Route not found" to a GET. A placeholder Authorization or X-API-Key of dashes, or no header, is accepted
chaining: pairs with prototypes that need a free OpenAI-shaped call; image and voice routes exist beside chat

limits.value: anonymous tier 8 requests per 10 s; a verified tier is 16 per 10 s (stated as "anon 8/10s · verified 16/10s")

binding_note: the anonymous tier ceiling of 8 per 10 s binds; what verification requires was not read

identity_cost.detail: none for the anonymous tier: auth is optional, and a placeholder or no header is accepted as anonymous. A verified tier raises the quota; what verifying needs was not read: unverified

reliability_note: the page claims 98.7% uptime over 90 days; no x-ratelimit header is returned on GET /v1/models, only CORS headers
confidence_note: the model list was read by a keyless GET; no completion was sent because probe issues GET and HEAD only, so the echoed model and the answer are unverified

evidence.quote: Free public beta — no key required · placeholders like \---------- are accepted
evidence.proved: the page states a free public beta with no key required

evidence.quote: Auth is optional. Send `Authorization: Bearer ----------` (any number of dashes), `X-API-Key: ----------`, or nothing — all accepted as anonymous.
evidence.proved: auth is optional and no header at all is accepted as anonymous
the published rate limit is 8 per 10 s anonymous and 16 per 10 s verified
a keyless GET /v1/models answered 200 with the model list

notes: ids such as claude-sonnet-3.5 and gemini-2.5-pro are labelled by their upstream vendor in the listing and are served through the freeAI gateway backend named on the page; the served model is unverified
